caption: The same uncut train station shot continues smoothly. The same adult woman turns back to face the camera and settles into the original pose. Her copper bob haircut with blunt bangs, olive skin, green eyes, silver nose stud, navy wool coat, mustard yellow striped scarf, black leather gloves, and square tan satchel remain stable and recognizable. Smooth continuous motion, no camera cut, fluorescent station lighting, shallow depth of field.
